# Squire

> Squire is the deploy kit for Citadel. It writes your app's build, release and health-check scripts from templates, checks them with squire doctor, and runs the app locally on Citadel's PHP image behind the same kind of proxy.

**Suits you up for deploy day.** A squire carries the kit, readies the armor and gets the knight on the field.

Checks: `composer ci` (the same command runs on GitLab and GitHub).

Squire is the Citadel kit: build.sh, the release script, the health check, and local parity on the real images. Its docs builder turns `docs/` into the committed pages under `site/docs/`, with a changelog page generated from `CHANGELOG.md` when the nav lists one. Its docs.css styles those pages in light and dark themes (an explicit choice first, then the system setting), with every text pair at WCAG AA contrast in both. It is part of WELD, the Wayne State application stack, beside WayneUI (project 0, the interface layer), CREED, PROCTOR, Preflight, SESAME, HELMET, Pinstripe and Sourdough.

**Not to be confused with:** `squire doctor` checks deploy setup only; standards checks are PROCTOR's.

> A knight never suits up alone. Your app shouldn't deploy alone either.

Front page: [`site/index.html`](https://nougat.snu.gs/enterprise-apps/squire/blob/HEAD/site/index.html), a static page you can serve from anywhere.
On Citadel it is served by the raw-PHP deploy layer in [`deploy/`](https://nougat.snu.gs/enterprise-apps/squire/blob/HEAD/deploy/): a Squire kit whose front controller serves `site/` behind HELMET's security headers. For local development, keep serving `site/` directly.

Status: 0.5.0, tagged and on Packagist.

Every page below is Markdown. The HTML pages send the same Markdown to a client that asks for `text/markdown`. Written by Squire's agent-ready kit from the README and the pages; do not edit.
